title: Combination of ranibizumab and indomethacin for neovascular age-related macular degeneration: randomized controlled trial

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (article <license>, ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/3.0/; Dove Medical Press terms)

groups.description: RM group of an open-label randomized pilot trial (Brescia, NCT03261635) in treatment-naive neovascular AMD: three monthly ranibizumab injections, then monthly visits with injections as needed for 12 months.

groups.agent: ranibizumab 0.5 mg intravitreal plus topical indomethacin 0.5% three times daily
groups.description: RI group (declared experimental arm): ranibizumab as in the RM group plus self-administered indomethacin 0.5% eye drops three times a day for 12 months.

decision: excluded: no admissible series (both randomized groups are analysed as complete-case sets after excluding treated patients lost after the loading phase)

exclusions.what: Table 2 (t2-opth-12-587) visual acuity rows of the RM and RI groups at baseline and 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 months
exclusions.reason: complete-case analysis set: one randomized and treated patient per group was excluded after the ranibizumab loading phase because they moved to another clinic, and the analysed 29 + 29 patients are those who completed the 12-month study; the article states that treated eyes were left out (protocol inclusion 5; brief complete-case ruling)

exclusions.what: Table 1 (t1-opth-12-587) baseline visual acuity (LogMAR) and range
exclusions.reason: baseline only, same excluded analysis set

exclusions.what: Mean BCVA changes and 12-month means in the Abstract and Results text
exclusions.reason: text values of the same excluded analysis set

notes: Table 2 labels the row 'Visual acuity (mean +/- SD)' without a unit; the Methods state that best-corrected visual acuity was measured as the ETDRS letter score, and Table 1 and the Results report the values in LogMAR. Unit and best-corrected status would be established, but the analysis set is complete-case.
Role: the ranibizumab plus topical indomethacin arm is the declared experimental arm (treated, combination); ranibizumab monotherapy is control.
The enrolment count (sixty participants) and the randomized group sizes are not fully consistent in the text; the excluded patients are those who moved away after the loading phase.
Central retinal thickness (Table 2), injection counts and adverse events (Table 3) are reported in the article and mentioned here only.
No record is written: the study has no admissible series under extraction protocol 1.0.0 and the extraction brief.
